entries.title: Spamhaus Nightmare: Domain Shut Down, No Notice, Over A Million Pages Down

Our company provides tools to help people put together pages for their businesses. Our free tool has been used to create over million page tabs on Facebook. entries.guide_zh: 作者称域名未获通知即被停用、上百万页面下线，求助处理 Spamhaus 纠纷。

entries.excerpt: Hacker News - I'm working on a mobile application called MinoMonsters. Our user numbers are exploding off the charts and our backend is failing. It's silently crashing without leaving a trace. It's getting into some hard to reproduce states. entries.guide_zh: MinoMonsters 用户激增、Ruby 后端无痕崩溃，作者紧急求助排障。
